section_1_gene_symbol_fixes.description: Correct PARK2→PRKN and fix hardcoded PARKIN in expected_evidence
notes: PARK2 is not the HGNC canonical symbol; PRKN is. PARKIN is the protein name.
All 6 PARK2 entries should have gene_symbol changed to PRKN.
All 20 entries have A.gene_symbol evidence value 'PARKIN' — should match actual gene.
GBA (not GBA1) is kept as-is per PD literature convention.
selection.json and meta.json do not store gene_symbol separately — no sync needed.

section_2_duplicate_variants.description: Identify and deduplicate repeated variant_hgvs_p values

affected_entries.recommendation: Remove exact duplicates; keep distinct HGVS expressions even if they describe the same variant

notes: Only parkinson_012 has exact duplicates: N370S×2, L444P×2.
These appear to be genuine repeated mentions in a complex GBA review article.
Recommendation: keep one instance of each unique value; variant_count field not used.

notes: segregation: 14 entries mention segregation — write 'reported' only (structured extraction needs expert review).
functional_assay: 13 entries mention functional studies — write 'reported' only.
contradiction: 10 entries mention conflicting evidence — manual review required, do NOT auto-write.

rules: No external knowledge may be used — only source.md text.
No PMID/abstract-level knowledge beyond what appears in source.md.
evidence_strength='uncertain' items are NEVER auto-written; they go to manual_review_fields only.
Every new field must have a source_snippet traceable to source.md original text.
Gene symbol corrections use HGNC 2025-06 canonical symbols only.
Variant deduplication preserves distinct HGVS expressions; removes only exact string duplicates.
